incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate and tail latency on inference-pool-3 (continuous-batching + kv-cache path). Auto-signal created at 2026-03-15T00:13:09Z. Priority: P1
Maya SRE: seeing errors spike ~00:10UTC, 5xxs are mostly cache-mismatch errors (KV lookup returned out-of-range offsets).
Javier EngRuntime: looking now. tagging @Maya SRE. any customer-facing impact yet?
Maya SRE: Ken from support says three customers reported degraded completions and incorrect continuations. Not complete data loss but corrupted continuation tokens.
Ken Support: confirmed — two enterprise tenants saw repeated bad seq offsets for chat sessions, causing weird token repeats. Tickets #C-4021 and #C-4022 opened.
Priya ML: this smells like KV reuse correctness — stale KV pages being served across requests when batching folds streams together. Could be the new paged-KV LRU change we rolled last week.
Javier EngRuntime: rolling back the paged-kv LRU change is an option, but we should try safer hotfix first: disable KV reuse across batch siblings (feature flag).
Lena Eng-Platform: oncall handoff in 20m. Maya, do you want me to take over the coordination if you need rest?
Maya SRE: please stay, I’ll hand off if it runs long. Action plan: 1) apply runtime flag disable_kv_reuse=true on pool 3 2) reduce continuous batch max_window from 64->8 3) monitor 5xx and latency.
Javier EngRuntime: preparing hotfix. Pushing config via deploy api:```bash
# apply flag to pool 3
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://ops.redwood.internal/api/v1/pools/3/config -d '{"disable_kv_reuse": true, "continuous_batch.max_window": 8}'
```
OpsBot: deploy-request received (id: dr-2113456789-1). Can run canary to 10% first.
Maya SRE: canary to 10% only — but we need to ensure no further cross-request leak. Javier, start canary then hold for 3m.
Javier EngRuntime: canary started -> dr-2113456789-1 -> 10% of pool3 nodes (12 pods). Logs: starting rollout...
(approx 60s later) Javier EngRuntime: canary looks OK: no 5xxs in the canary nodes, tail latency stable. Proceeding to 100% rollout.
OpsBot: rollout to 100% scheduled, estimated 3m.
Maya SRE: support, please DM customers informing we’ve applied a hotfix and we’re monitoring. Ken Support: will send. Suggested message: "We applied a temporary fix to our inference runtime to stop stale cache reuse while we investigate. You may see reduced throughput for a few minutes; correctness should be restored."
Ken Support: message sent to C-4021/C-4022.
Javier EngRuntime: rollout complete. Post-rollout quick-check: 5xxs dropped from 2.8% -> 0.1%, latency p95 down from 1.6s -> 1.1s.
Maya SRE: confirming customer attachments — Ken, any follow-ups?
Ken Support: customers report completions look normal now; one tenant asks for postmortem.
Priya ML: grabbing traces — I see instances where seq_offset in KV pages remained at an earlier context id when batching merged two streams. Likely cause: reuse index not invalidated when request boundary moved during batching.
Javier EngRuntime: reproducer in local sim: when continuous_batch.window > 16 and paged-kv LRU evicts page A and reassigns slot to page B, a concurrent request can still reference slot index before the update. We missed an atomic seq_offset bump.
Maya SRE: root-cause hypothesis: non-atomic swap of page metadata + reuse without seq_offset bump -> stale keys served.
Lena Eng-Platform: created incident doc in /incidents/2113456789 on the runbook. Adding tasks: (1) add seq_offset atomic increment on page assignment (2) add unit tests for cross-request reuse (3) tighten canary policy for paged-kv changes.
Javier EngRuntime: PR incoming (WIP) to ensure page assignment updates the seq_offset and to gate reuse behind a generation check. Will link when ready.
Maya SRE: for now mitigation = disable_kv_reuse + lower batching window. Metrics look healthy. Are there customers that need a rollback?
Ken Support: all affected customers reported restored behavior. No rollbacks requested.
OpsBot: incident auto-update: severity reduced to P2 at 00:27UTC after rollback of risky change.
Maya SRE: timeline: detection 00:13UTC, hotfix canary 00:16UTC, full rollout 00:20UTC, stabilization 00:26UTC.
Priya ML: next steps: schedule an eval-run against a synthetic workload that mimics high interleaving to catch seq_offset regressions. I'll add eval tests.
Javier EngRuntime: PR 4927 opened: "Ensure paged-kv assignment is generation-safe" link: https://coderepo.redwood.internal/eng-runtime/pulls/4927
Lena Eng-Platform: tagging eng-runtime/eng-ml for a coordinated postmortem. Please include root cause, timeline, mitigation, test coverage, and a rollback checklist.
Maya SRE: thanks team. I’ll draft the incident summary and assign action items. If anything else pops up, @here. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident 2113456789: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem required.
